decisions.choice: Appended the word ", verified" to the single existing line of notes.txt, leaving its meaning intact.
decisions.whyItMatters: It keeps notes.txt accurate and current by recording that the note has been checked, without removing or contradicting the original content a reader relies on.

alternatives.option: Rewrite the line entirely to a new statement unrelated to the original.
alternatives.consequence: The original note would be lost, so anyone relying on the recorded text would read something different from what was previously written.

alternatives.option: Add a second line with the new remark.
alternatives.consequence: The file would no longer be a single-line note, breaking the file's stated one-line shape.

recommendation.choice: Append ", verified" to the existing line
recommendation.reason: It records the new information while preserving the original text and the single-line structure, so the file stays accurate and minimal.

assumptions: The intended change is to annotate the existing note rather than replace its content, since no other instructions about the note's text were given.
